name: clickables
architecture: SIGN-style network: 6 view encoders (92->48), head 288->48->1; 40705 parameters

data.note: Tranco top-1000 crawl; retained direct positive labels and non-delegated negative labels; reduced single-seed ablations

comparisons.model: Rule: pointer cursor and not native

seeds.note: test PR-AUC of the graph network trained with each seed; the shipped seed was chosen on calibration sites

latency.target: <= 50 ms for 2,000 elements in the Web Worker
latency.note: median of 10 runs in the app's Web Worker; headless Chromium, 16 Ãƒâ€” AMD Ryzen 7 7435HS, no CPU throttling

failurePatterns: Manual error review is pending. The current errors report contains 151 false positives and 68 false negatives; recurring causes have not yet been established.
limitations: The Tranco top-1000 crawl produced 1407 page records. Of these, 879 pages were used, contributing candidate rows from 450 unique sites.
The retained training corpus contains 18345 rows: 8751 positive and 9594 negative. It retains direct positive labels and non-delegated negative labels; delegated negatives were filtered upstream.
All examples belong to the Tranco crawl category. This experiment does not provide a representative breakdown across site types or industries.
The split is site-disjoint: 315 training sites, 68 calibration sites and 67 test sites.
Labels are based on automated event-listener and React handler probing. Delegated event handlers and ancestor-level interactions are known sources of label noise.

The automated label audit sampled 300 candidates: 188 were judged, 112 were unsure and zero errors were found among the 188 judged. Only four positive labels were judged. This is not a completed independent manual owner review.
On the test split, the shipped SIGN model achieved PR-AUC 0.9708, precision 0.8925, recall 0.9486 and ECE 0.0883, with 151 false positives and 68 false negatives.

The best neighbourhood gradient-boosting baseline achieved PR-AUC 0.9855, higher than the shipped SIGN model. The SIGN model therefore fails the precision, baseline-comparison and calibration shipping gates.
The ONNX model is 169515 bytes. Browser benchmarking processed 2664 elements at a median of 10 ms across 10 runs, passing the 50 ms latency requirement.
The model must remain off by default until all required quality gates pass.

labelProbe.method: Random sample of labelled candidates; each clicked once at its centre in the live page. "responds": the DOM, address or a dialog changed within 400 ms. Skipped as untestable: pages that change by themselves, and elements whose centre is a link or button. A response can still come from a handler on an ancestor, so disagreement is an upper bound on label noise.
